resources.string:
Objective
The goal of Tic Tac Toe is to be the first player to get three of your marks in a row — horizontally, vertically, or diagonally — on a 3x3 grid.

Setup
The game is played on a 3x3 grid.
Two players participate: one uses "X" and the other uses "O".
Players decide who goes first (usually "X").

How to Play
Players take turns placing their mark (X or O) in an empty cell on the grid.
Only one mark can be placed per turn.
Players alternate turns until the game ends.

Winning the Game
A player wins by placing three of their marks in a straight line:
Horizontally (across any row)
Vertically (down any column)
Diagonally (either of the two diagonal lines)

Draw
If all nine cells are filled and no player has three in a row, the game ends in a draw (tie).
